caption: A puff of breath blows out the candles on a birthday cake, and thin wisps of smoke rise from the wicks.

sa.check: Lit candles stand on a birthday cake.
A puff of breath is blown at them.
Wisps of smoke rise from the wicks.
The puff comes first, then the flames go out, then the smoke.

pc.expect: The flames lean away from the breath and go out during it.
pc.fail: The flames stay upright during the puff; or go out before the puff; or lean toward the breath.

pc.expect: Once out the candles stay out, and the smoke follows the flame.
pc.fail: The candles relight on their own; or smoke rises before a flame is out; or a flame comes back from the smoke.
It sinks; or hangs; or flows sideways with no draught.

pc.expect: The smoke is thin wisps that thin out.
pc.fail: It is a solid rope; or a liquid; or a dense blob that holds its shape.

pc.expect: The candles keep their number and the cake stays one cake.
pc.fail: A candle vanishes; or a new one appears; or the cake changes into another object.

pc.expect: The cake's frosting and the candles stay the same.
pc.fail: The frosting changes colour; or the candles rearrange; or the table changes.

note: The breath is kept as the trigger; the person blowing is not judged.
